::: {.csf-hero}
<p class="csf-hero__eyebrow"><i class="bi bi-heart-fill"></i> Since March 2022</p>

<h1 class="csf-hero__title">The dessert is easy. The <em>group</em> is the recipe.</h1>

<p class="csf-hero__lede">
Cuochi senza fuochi started in Padova in March 2022, among people who lived a few streets
apart, had never spoken to each other, and between them owned about one working oven.
<strong>We still don't use ovens. We do have each other's numbers now.</strong>
</p>
:::

::: {.csf-section}
::: {.csf-split}
::: {}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">our mission</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">Help people meet, over something sweet and cheap.</h2>
:::

::: {}
We bring strangers around one table to make an easy dessert together.

Making something with your hands takes the pressure off. You don't have to think of
what to say, because there is always a biscuit to crush or a bowl to pass. By the time
the cake comes out of the fridge, you're not strangers any more.

We keep it **cheap**, so nobody stays home because of money. We keep it **easy**, so
nobody stays home because they "can't cook". And we keep it **friendly**, so nobody
feels they have to prove anything.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">why the group matters</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">One person with a recipe makes a snack. Fifteen make an evening.</h2>
<p class="csf-section__sub">
The dessert is never the hard part. The good part is what happens around the table
while it's being made.
</p>

::: {.csf-grid}
::: {.csf-card .csf-card--berry}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-hand-index-thumb-fill"></i></span>

### Everyone has a job
Someone crushes, someone melts, someone layers, someone does the tasting. Nobody stands
around watching, so nobody stands around alone.
:::

::: {.csf-card .csf-card--butter}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-house-heart-fill"></i></span>

### Nobody is a guest
There's no chef and no audience. We made it together, so it belongs to everyone at the
table, including the person who arrived ten minutes ago.
:::

::: {.csf-card .csf-card--pista}
<span class="csf-card__icon"><i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat"></i></span>

### It keeps going
People come back, bring a flatmate, offer their kitchen table for the next one. That's
how a one-off evening turns into a group.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">the name</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">Why "cooks without fires"?</h2>

::: {.csf-split}
::: {}
Because nobody involved had a real kitchen. Student rooms and shared flats come with
two hobs that half work, no oven, and a fridge shared between five people.

That could have been a reason not to do it. Instead it became the rule that makes it
work: **if the recipe needs no fire, everybody can take part**, including the person who
has never made anything in their life.
:::

::: {}
It also decides what we make. Desserts and cakes are where cooking without heat stops
being a compromise: things that get crushed, whipped, layered and left in the fridge.

The barrier to joining is turning up. That's it.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">to be clear</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">What we are, and what we aren't</h2>

::: {.csf-split}
::: {.csf-checks}
- **A group of people.** Students, researchers, workers, newcomers and locals.
- **Free and open.** Anyone can come, especially if you don't know anyone yet.
- **A place to laugh.** At the conversation, and at the occasional collapsed cheesecake.
- **Growing, one city at a time.** Padova first, [maybe yours next](cities.qmd).
:::

::: {.csf-checks .csf-isnt}
- **Not a competition.** No jury, no ranking, no "best dessert". We all eat the same cake.
- **Not a cooking class.** Nobody is paid and nobody pays. Nobody grades your whisking.
- **Not a potluck.** Please don't bring a dish. Everything is already there.
- **Not a dating app or a networking event.** People do help each other with flats and
  jobs, but the way neighbours do, not because it's the agenda.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">who runs it</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">All of us, a bit at a time</h2>
<p class="csf-section__sub">
A small rotating group of people who have been coming since the start. Whoever has the
space that month hosts and does the shopping; everybody else turns up. There's no
committee, and nothing to join beyond arriving.
</p>

Have a big table and a fridge with room in it? Say so: that's how the next sessions get
scheduled. Live somewhere else? [Start one in your city](cities.qmd).
:::
